name: garmin-personal-api-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your own Garmin Connect data (runs with exact splits, VO2 max, training load, sleep, HRV, Body Battery, weight) through Garmin's official, read-only Personal API.

api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken (Garmin Connect → Settings → Personal API → Create Key). Leave empty to use a key saved on this computer with `npx garmin-personal-api-mcp setup`.
